rule.name: UnclosedInlineResource
rule.message: This closeable (a stream, reader, writer, channel, JAR or ZIP file, class loader or JDBC connection) is opened and used in the same expression, as the receiver of a call, an argument or a loop source, so nothing closes it: each call leaks a file handle or a connection, and on Windows the file stays locked. Open it in a try-with-resources header and use the variable (try (InputStream in = resource.getInputStream()) ... in.readAllBytes()). Returning it, storing it in a field of a closeable class, or passing it to a closeable wrapper (new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(in))) that is itself owned also matches. In-memory types (ByteArrayInputStream, StringReader, StringWriter) and streams owned elsewhere (System.in, a Socket, a Process, a servlet response) are not reported.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $closeable := 'java.lang.AutoCloseable', $skipped := ('java.io.ByteArrayInputStream', 'java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream', 'java.io.StringReader', 'java.io.StringWriter', 'java.io.CharArrayReader', 'java.io.CharArrayWriter', 'java.util.stream.BaseStream', 'com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonParser', 'com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonGenerator', 'tools.jackson.core.JsonParser', 'tools.jackson.core.JsonGenerator', 'java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService', 'java.net.http.HttpClient'), $owners := ('java.lang.Process', 'java.net.Socket', 'java.util.zip.ZipFile', 'javax.servlet.ServletRequest', 'javax.servlet.ServletResponse', 'jakarta.servlet.ServletRequest', 'jakarta.servlet.ServletResponse'), $opening := concat('^(?:(?:open|new|create|prepare|accept|connect|build)(?:[A-Z_].*)?', '|getInputStream|getOutputStream|getResourceAsStream|getSystemResourceAsStream|getConnection)$'), $fresh := function($n, $self) { exists($n[self::MethodCall or self::ConstructorCall][pmd-java:typeIs($closeable)]) and not(some $t in $skipped satisfies exists($n[pmd-java:typeIs($t)])) and (if (exists($n/ArgumentList/*[pmd-java:typeIs($closeable)])) then (some $a in $n/ArgumentList/*[pmd-java:typeIs($closeable)] satisfies $self($a, $self)) else if (exists($n/self::ConstructorCall)) then not($n[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Scanner')]/ArgumentList/*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.String')]) and not($n[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Formatter')] [empty(ArgumentList/*) or ArgumentList/*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.StringBuilder')]]) else (matches($n/@MethodName, $opening) and not(some $t in $owners satisfies exists($n/*[1][pmd-java:typeIs($t)])))) } return //(MethodCall | ConstructorCall)[$fresh(., $fresh)] [not(self::MethodCall/*[1][$fresh(., $fresh)])] [parent::MethodCall[not(@MethodName = 'close')] or parent::ForeachStatement or parent::ArgumentList[not(parent::ExplicitConstructorInvocation)] [not(..[pmd-java:typeIs($closeable) or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.beans.factory.DisposableBean')])] [not(matches(../@MethodName, '^(?:close\w*|register|exit|add\w*|put\w*|offer\w*|push|set[A-Z]\w*|of|ofNullable)$'))] [not(..[@MethodName = ('readValue', 'readValues', 'readTree')] /*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper') or pmd-java:typeIs('com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectReader') or pmd-java:typeIs('tools.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper') or pmd-java:typeIs('tools.jackson.databind.ObjectReader')])] [not(../*[1][self::TypeExpression][pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.util.FileCopyUtils')])]]
